Recorded claim:
`TreeViewTable` already owns focus on `tbody[role="treegrid"]` (`tabIndex=0`) via `currentIndex` and `aria-activedescendant`; Ctrl/accel+arrow moves current focus without changing selection. Do not add a per-card roving tabindex model unless the shared treegrid contract changes. [Task 2]
